searchText: Hey <@388610194608750595> I'm looking into the task of generating a new test vector set to start early testing of the builder API changes from EIP-4844 Would you mind sharing more context on the process flashbots team follows to test this kind of fork changes. Thank you Not sure if this is useful, but just reading through some tests on the `mev-boost` code base, and saw a test for `GetPayload`, which uses data from `consensus-spec-tests` https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/blob/main/server/service_test.go#L629 I guess this will need to be updated for Capella & EIP-4844 https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/blob/main/testdata/signed-blinded-beacon-block-case0.json
